verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents self-hosting its rendezvous/relay server with a Docker compose file (oss.yml) under an AGPL-licensed OSS server, and lets you host the web client on your own domain. Community users confirm running their own lookup/relay server for years and getting a Docker-hosted server working; isolated reports of difficulty or poor performance do not show that self-hosting fails as claimed. missing for 10: authentication, web console and access control on the free OSS self-hosted server (these are gated to Server Pro), encryption not enabled by default, and consistently smooth setup (some users found it hard).
